summary_en: ZENKOKU HOSHO authorized acquisition of up to 4.0 million shares (2.99% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 8.0 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 6, 2026 through March 31, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency and return profits to shareholders.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, ZENKOKU HOSHO's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 156 of the Companies Act, as applied with modifications pursuant to Article 165(3). The company will acquire up to 4.0 million ordinary shares, representing 2.99% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate price of 8.0 billion yen.

The acquisition will be conducted through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 6, 2026 through March 31, 2027. No per-share price limit has been disclosed. The stated rationale is to enhance capital efficiency and return profits to shareholders, thereby improving corporate value.

As of October 31, 2026, the company held 4,110,465 treasury shares against 133,633,115 issued shares excluding treasury stock.
